facts.fact: The health roadmap says the Universal Access Development Fund was 'established through' the National Digital Development Policy in the Ministry of Communications, Technology, and Innovations, as a funding source for universal access; the document does not describe the policy's scope.

note: A health-sector roadmap (thematic). The national strategies appear only as listed ICT frameworks and in a milestone figure; the one fact is the fund created through the 2021 policy, dated to the policy year since the document gives no other date.
